**Finding: Compliant** (Rule LD — Liquidated damages and penalties payable by Customer)

The agreement meets the **preferred** position: there are no liquidated damages, penalties, or early-termination/minimum fees payable by Corio.

What I checked:
- **§4 Fees / Exhibit B Pricing & Payment Terms** — only ordinary consideration (license, annual maintenance/support, MarketSite.net access, capped time-and-materials implementation, revenue share). No late-payment penalty or default interest.
- **§11 Term & Termination** — non-renewal on 30 days' notice; termination for uncured material breach or insolvency. No termination fee, no acceleration of remaining contract value. §11.3's continuing support payments are fee-for-value for services Corio elects to keep receiving, not a liquidated amount.
- **§§3, 7, 8 remedies** — refund and indemnity mechanics run in Corio's favour, so they are not flagged.
- **§9 Limitation of Liability** — caps liability at amounts actually paid by Corio and waives consequentials, reinforcing the absence of any fixed damages formula against us.

No redline proposed.
